assets.prompt: Use case: game background asset. Reference is the approved Share Splitter screenshot. Generate ONLY the environmental background layer for implementing this game, not another screenshot. Match the same premium stylized 3D/painterly family fantasy art, warm lantern-lit riverside garden party at blue hour, waterfalls and distant glowing castle, teal river, bunting, leafy trees and flowers, gifts and warm hanging lanterns around the far left/right edges. Landscape 16:9 composition. Remove all interface, all text, ALL characters/guests, ALL tables, plates, food, trays and buttons. The entire lower 65 percent should be an uncluttered dark warm garden terrace with subtle stone floor and atmospheric soft shadows where a separate banquet table asset will be composited. Keep the brightest environmental details around outer edges and upper third, leaving calm usable center. Soft depth of field to ensure separately composited game pieces read clearly. No letters, symbols, labels or watermark. This is a production background asset for the current Share Splitter game.

Edit this production Share Splitter guest sprite sheet. Preserve EXACTLY the same five character designs, expressions, rendering and left-to-right order. Fix sprite-sheet spacing for use in real code: use a wide 3:1 transparent canvas divided into FIVE EQUAL imaginary vertical cells. Put character centers EXACTLY at 10%,30%,50%,70%,90% of total canvas width. Scale every character down so its ENTIRE silhouette fits within 70% of its own cell width, leaving at least 15% transparent padding at BOTH sides of EVERY cell. No ears, hands, horns, clothes or effects may cross a cell boundary. Keep the five characters at consistent visual height, bottom baseline at 90% of canvas height. These transparent gaps are essential: the characters MUST NOT touch one another. Preserve true transparent alpha background. No text, gridlines, additional objects or shadows. Leave the alpha padding empty. All five isolated waist-up party guests fully visible.
